synopsis: Chapter 12 and the glossary consistently describe the cone of uncertainty as popular but not borne out by project data [f10144, f16334, f10321]. Chapter 12 specifically identifies McConnell’s 2006 cone and project data reported by Little in 2006 as the basis for this disagreement [f9636]. The planning recommendation is therefore not to present the cone as a precise model [f9637]. The supplied facts do not quantify the discrepancy or identify a replacement model [f10144, f16334, f9636, f9637, f10321].
